mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.game_level_configs (game_id, min_level, max_level) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{minLevel}, #{maxLevel}) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET min_level = EXCLUDED.min_level, max_level = EXCLUDED.max_level, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT character_key FROM public.characters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY character_key ASC
SELECT game_id, character_key, name, description, created_at, updated_at FROM public.characters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND character_key = #{characterKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.characters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND character_key = #{characterKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.characters (game_id, character_key, name, description) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{characterKey}, #{name}, #{description})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.characters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND character_key = #{characterKey}
mapper.select: SELECT attribute_key, value_type, min_value, max_value FROM public.attributes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC, attribute_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.character_attributes (game_id, character_key, level_values) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{characterKey}, CAST(#{levelValuesJson} AS jsonb))
